_README: Hand-verified repairs for defects in the UPSTREAM statute sources.
This file is committed (CLAUDE.md .gitignore: data/mappings/ is source of
truth) and is the ONLY sanctioned place to add statutory text that did not
come out of an ingested source. Every entry must be transcribed from real
gazette or India Code text and have its provenance recorded in 'source'.
Text must NEVER be written here from memory or generated by a model. A
system whose premise is that a citation is real only if it exists in
ingested data cannot have invented provisions seeded into its own corpus.
An entry with an empty 'text' is an ACKNOWLEDGED GAP: the ingest reports it
and omits the section rather than emitting a stub the verifier would bless.

304B.note: GAP. civictech-India ships section_desc as "" in ipc.json and NULL in IndiaLaw.db -- the defect is upstream and present in both formats, not a parsing error on our side. indiacode.nic.in serves its root but times out on every /bitstream/ and /handle/ path from this network, so the authoritative text could not be fetched. Dowry death is outside the theft/assault/cheating/common-intention offence types Phase 1 curates for, so this is not on the critical path; transcribe from the gazette before any work that depends on s304B.
